d: What if one private family quietly controlled the journey of your food, from the farm where it's grown to the meal on your plate? In this episode of The Blueprint, we uncover the hidden story of Cargill, the largest privately owned company in America and one of the most influential corporations in the global food industry. For over 150 years, the Cargill-MacMillan family has built a vast agricultural empire spanning grain trading, food processing, shipping, logistics, commodities, and global supply chains.
